_how: prediction defaults of eurelaps_lung (the 3D Slicer extension starts from these): the model and solver settings of the calibrated model (analysis/results.md 5f, 7d). The caller sets patient, data_dir, output_dir, inputs, and the collapse (eurelaps_lung.predict.run(cfg, collapse=..)). Keys and ranges: configs/README.md

inputs._comment: surfaces (data_dir), LPS or RAS tagged in the file header: the inflated lung to collapse, optionally the collapsed lung (same coordinates: the errors are then reported), and the three trees for the hilum

hilum._comment: inflated: the hilum from the inflated lung, also when a collapsed lung is given, so that the prediction does not depend on it (the cohort fits used the collapsed lung: analysis/results.md 7e)

fem_setup._comment: clamp: triangles within sphere radius x radius_factor of the anchor points. wall.surface: 'reference' (the inflated surface), a file, or null; grid_mm / smoothing_mm: the wall as a smooth field (solver.wall_update potential). regions: {levels: [...]} only for physics.perturbation regions

physics._comment: a parameter is a number (fixed) or {fit: true, init, bounds} (fitted by the fit step). gravity: position of the inflated CT and of the collapse (supine | prone | left_lateral | right_lateral | [x, y, z] LPS), null = no gravity. collapse: q0 (p/E) | p0_Pa | volume_ratio. perturbation (fit only): null | {gradient: [ap, si, ml]} | {regions: [K, ...]}. E_Pa {rule: collapse}: E from the collapse %, the built-in rule of the Netgen-mesh cohort fits (config.E_RULE_A, E_RULE_B; calibrated on supine -> supine, collapse 23-86 %). collapse.volume_ratio: set by the caller (predict.run(collapse=..))

solver._comment: torch core on the CPU in float64, SciPy SuperLU: the same on every platform (the same results on the Mac and in 3D Slicer). On a CUDA server: device null, linear_solver null (auto: cuda + cuDSS)
